title: Exam MCQ

tests.name: A exam
tests.code:
String out = CjTestBase.capture(() -> Solution.program());
CjTestBase.checkTrue(out.startsWith("A"), "answer must start with the correct letter");
tests.hint: A. Row sum (1+2+3=6) plus column sum (1+4=5) minus the double-counted corner g[0][0]=1 → 6+5-1 = 10. B subtracts the corner twice; C sums the whole grid; D forgets the corner subtraction.
